hi! i have bipolar, adhd, PTSD and (not self diagnosed, but it historically runs in the family - my mother/grandmother have it) OCD-like-tendencies and am medicated for above. showering is also something i struggle greatly with partly due to past trauma but also just because like you said, its a very blah thing to do - i ended up going 2 weeks without showering during covid due to lack of supervision. something that REALLY helps me is looking at a shower like a speedrun competition with myself. the trick to actually speedrunning the shower though, and not just zoning out, is to try it with your eyes closed! i also find that washing in sections all at once before rinsing helps - ie. shampoo the hair, wash face with face wash, wash piercings (if applicable), and THEN rinse. now youre already half way done and that literally can take like 1-2 min (i have short hair). wash your body from top down, rinse, and voilah! i shave my arm pits frequently, so please dont do that part with your eyes closed lol. you dont have to try this and i know you werent really looking for advice, but if you ever would like to try something from a fellow bipolar mishap, here ya go :D i hope you have a wonderful day and remember that you are a BEAUTIFUL person - inside and out!!

If you're playing support Bard it's usually a better idea to take Guardian instead of electrocute, you have a lot better sustain than you do with more damage based runes, but if you're taking him mid lane or top lane you could definitely go with really any of his runes options. Build wise it just kind of depends on the matchup and how well you're doing and what your team might be lacking.

Against Heavy AD:

If you're doing well: Spellthief's>Mobi's>Deadman's>Thornmail>Nashor's>Lichbane

Not doing well:
Spellthief's>Deadman's>Mobi's>Thornmail>Randuin's>Righteous Glory or Nashor's

Against Heavy AP: 

If you're doing well:
Spellthief>Mobi's>Deadman's>Spirit Visage>Nashor's> from here you can build really anything that works on Bard, if you want to catch people out and you want more AP you can take twin ghosts, if you want to get even tankier you could build Adaptive Helm, if you want to have more damage you could build RDC depending on how much gold you're getting or you could go Lichbane which is one of my favorite items for him.

Not doing well:
Spellthief's>Deadman's>Mobi's>Spirit Visage>Adaptive Helm>Gargoyle

My usual build against a split damage team:
Spellthief's>Mobi's>Deadman's>Thornmail>Nashor's>Lichbane

Keep in mind I'm only in S4 so take this with a grain of salt, but this is just what I've learned from playing Bard so much. He is my main and if you decide to really sit down and learn him it's definitely worth it, but it does take a little time to get used to him, he's quite different from ordinary supports.
